title: The next research grants are Plus, not Pro, and first come.
friendlyTitle: The next research accounts are the cheaper plan, and first come.
summary: On 16 November, OpenAI said the next round of ChatGPT for Academic Researchers opens on 23 November and will award 50,000 grants, first come, first served. Each grant covers the recipient and up to two collaborators on ChatGPT Plus, not Pro. The program's stated goal is 200,000 researchers, after a summer pilot that reached 20,000 people in 33 countries.
friendlySummary: On 16 November, OpenAI said the next round of free ChatGPT for researchers opens on 23 November. It will give 50,000 grants to people who qualify, in the order applications arrive. Each grant covers the researcher and up to two colleagues on ChatGPT Plus, not the more expensive Pro plan. The aim is 200,000 researchers in all.
whyItMatters: If you are already on the waitlist and qualify, OpenAI says it will email you before applications open. By default, data shared through the program is not used to train models. Plus is the trade for more seats: OpenAI says most pilot users would have stayed inside those limits.
